 Order

1. Petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No. 132/2021 of PS Dwarka (North) for offence under Section 420/467/468/471 IPC on the ground that complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioner.

2. Broadly speaking, the prosecution allegation is that the petitioner forged the title documents of an immovable property in his name, which property was allegedly owned by the respondent no.2 (complainant de facto).
The petitioner and respondent no.2 having compromised the disputes, the present petition has been filed.
3. Learned APP for State and learned counsel for respondent no.2 accept This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 05/01/2026 at 20:32:46 notice and inform that chargesheet is awaiting order on cognizance.

4. It is further explained by learned APP on instructions of IO/SI Durgesh that the subject property was originally in the name of one Jitender, who allegedly sold it to one Swami Nath, who in turn sold the same to the present petitioner.
It is the documents from Jitender to Swami Nath and from Swami Nath to the petitioner, which are forged.

But no investigation has been carried out concerning Jitender or his legal representatives, as regards their title in the subject property, in order to rule out that two strangers have not colluded to deprive the actual owner of the property.
